version 17.9
hostname SYNTHETIC-SWITCH
aaa new-model
aaa authentication login MGMT local
username SYNTHETIC-ADMIN secret 9 SYNTHETIC-HASH
no ip http server
ip ssh version 2
ip access-list standard MGMT-VTY
 permit 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.255
!
snmp-server community SYNTHETIC-COMMUNITY RO MGMT-VTY
vlan 10
 name SYNTHETIC-USERS
!
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/1
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 10
 synthetic-layer-two-option enabled
!
line console 0
 login local
!
line vty 0 15
 transport input ssh
 access-class MGMT-VTY in vrf-also
 login authentication MGMT
end
